messages:
ana p: Hi team! First day — trying to get local services running on my M1 Mac. Redis starts fine but Postgres exits with permission denied during init when mounting ./pgdata. Any recommended quick fixes?

ana p: Log:
```
postgres_1  | initdb: could not create directory "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata": Permission denied
```

matt (eng): welcome, ana! :wave: Quick path: avoid bind mounts for the DB on mac — use a docker named volume. If you need a host folder, run a one-off container to chown it.

matt (eng): example:
```bash
docker volume create redwood_local_pgdata
# update compose to use redwood_local_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
```

infra-jun: also check image arch on Apple Silicon. If docker pulled amd64 under emulation, weird FS behavior can show up. Adding `platform: linux/arm64` to the postgres service in compose usually helps.

ana p: tried named volume, postgres starts but app reports connection refused; logs show postgres listening only on a socket.

matt (eng): ensure `ports: - "5432:5432"` and set `PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata`. Our dev compose snippet:
```yaml
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    platform: linux/arm64
    volumes:
      - redwood_local_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: redwood
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: localpass
      POSTGRES_DB: redwood_dev
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
volumes:
  redwood_local_pgdata: {}
```

helper-bot: Dev doc link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/dev-setup#postgres-local :link:

ana p: adding platform flag fixed it and app connects. One last thing: our helper scripts call host `psql` and break because the host can't read the docker volume files. Should I change local scripts to run in-container?

infra-jun: yes, update scripts to run `docker compose exec postgres psql ...` or run a short psql container with proper envs. We prefer containerized DB commands so CI/dev parity stays intact.

ana p: perfect — works now. Thanks all! I'll open a tiny docs PR to note the M1 + named volume tip. :tada:
